conventions.energy_unit: Delta; gap=Delta=1; bandwidth is the normal-state half-bandwidth D
conventions.nrg_energy_mapping: Source NRG branch totals have the analytic isolated bath vacuum and detuning subtracted; no additional shift is applied here
conventions.hybridization: gamma=total Gamma=pi*rho*|V|^2 for the single reservoir; rho=1/(2D) per spin
conventions.spin: S_z=(n_up-n_down)/2 in units of hbar; singlet total S_z=0, doublet total S_z=+1/2
conventions.normal_weights: Normal-state measure dxi/(2D), retained without renormalization
conventions.bath_levels: Total signed normal-state levels per reservoir; two Bogoliubov modes per level
conventions.frequency_window: Surrogate imaginary-frequency upper limit W/Delta; explicit fit metadata in input/baths.json
conventions.values: Lowest candidate root per branch; all ten observables dimensionless; negative signed_gap means doublet ground state
conventions.residuals: norm((H-E)*psi)/Delta; arrays retain every declared checked root, in energy order
conventions.finite_problem_qualified: Recorded residual and spin checks, plus DMRG sweep checks, for the declared roots only; not root completeness or a continuum error bound
conventions.seed_trial_counts: Number of trials at this endpoint, not necessarily independent; higher-bond continuation uses one warm trial
conventions.requested_observable_target: tau(X)=absolute+relative*abs(X_new), using the new endpoint backend; not an uncertainty
conventions.comparison_difference: new_value-old_value; NRG-minus-finite uses the chosen finite-Lambda twist mean as new
conventions.comparison_ratio: abs(difference)/scale; scale is always a requested target, never an error estimate
conventions.nrg_comparison: NRG-L2.0-K8000-Nz8 is a plotting/comparison point, not a continuum reference; no extrapolation or uncertainty is established

observables.signed_gap: g=(E_D-E_S)/Delta; negative means doublet ground state
observables.singlet.energy: E_S/Delta, lowest singlet candidate in the stated reference
observables.doublet.energy: E_D/Delta, lowest doublet candidate in the stated reference
observables.doublet.moment: Impurity <(n_up-n_down)/2> in the total S_z=+1/2 doublet

controls.reason: detuning energy offset, units, particle-hole relation and matched finite baths

assessment.nrg: Seven completed finite-Lambda twist means; continuum targets and empirical uncertainties are not established.
assessment.qp_dmrg: All QP endpoints pass their projected-H checks. Final DMRG singlet chi1024 and doublet chi768 pass untruncated finite-H checks. No continuum target is established.
assessment.root_completeness: One-root results do not establish root separation. Retain the branch-specific checks and seed counts rather than assuming test1 root coverage.
assessment.comparisons: Differences diagnose cutoff, bath, window, bond and NRG grid sensitivity; none is an error bound.
